evidence.text: Maintained the month-end demand model that forecasts batch volume from client, account and report counts, refreshing the coefficients each quarter from the platform's job-history tables.

evidence.text: Planned compute and storage for each month-end cycle with the platform team, translating the forecast into node reservations and storage headroom in the capacity plan.

evidence.text: Month-end batch overruns fell from 9 per cycle to 2 per cycle over the six cycles after the re-sequenced valuation jobs went live, as recorded in the platform's overrun report against its published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle for the preceding half-year.

Coordinated capacity changes with the platform and finance teams in the monthly capacity review; reservation changes were approved by the platform manager and the cost impact was signed off by finance.
